weapon.d: Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces. If unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice. At start of combat, if foe's HP ≥ 75%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit during combat.
Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces. If unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice. At start of combat, if foe's HP ≥ 75%, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit during combat.

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in a wide area around target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

a.d: If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+2 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+4 during combat.
If unit is not adjacent to an ally, grants Atk/Def+6 during combat.

c.d: Inflicts Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Inflicts Def-5 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Inflicts Def-7 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
